summary: Click Holdings Ltd. filed a 6-K announcing its acquisition of 100% equity of Axiom Digital Ltd. via a stock-only consideration of 4,500,000 Class A and 800,000 Class B ordinary shares. The target, wholly owned by CEO Chan Chun Sing (a related party), operates a construction HR tech platform in Hong Kong. The board recommends the deal; no termination fee, price per share, or premium is stated. Closing is expected in June 2026, subject to customary conditions. Watch for minority shareholder approval and fairness opinion disclosures given the related-party nature.
